name: agent-sandbox-persistent-runnable
goal: Make the Agent sandbox tier persist its session and actually run an agent (chat + tool loop) under OpenShell policy in the browser.

stories.title: Honest egress foundation
stories.description: Worker performs real fetch for allowlisted hosts, surfaces cors_or_network, denies the rest; network mode off/restricted/open. Needed before agent model calls.
acceptance: POST /egress with url performs real fetch when allowed
network mode wired from container settings

stories.title: Persist agent session model
stories.description: Extend Container + IndexedDB with agentSession (messages, console log) and agent settings (provider, model, apiBaseUrl, apiKey).
acceptance: Container type includes agentSession and inference settings
saveContainer persists them; reopen restores them
buildContainer initializes empty session for agent tier

stories.title: Worker agent turn + tools
stories.description: Add POST /agent/turn with OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic request shapes, tool loop (http_request, eval_js, fs_read/write/list) under policy, virtual FS in worker.
acceptance: /agent/turn calls model API via policy-gated fetch
Tools execute for real; policy denies block tools that egress
No invented assistant text when the model call fails

stories.title: Chat UI + settings
stories.description: AgentConsole: chat panel as primary, policy sidebar, provider/model/key/base URL fields, persist messages on each turn, restore on mount.
acceptance: User can send a chat message and see the assistant reply or honest error

stories.title: Presets, docs, verify
stories.description: Presets include systemPrompt + default provider/model; update ROADMAP/AGENTS/README; typecheck/lint/both builds; browser smoke.
acceptance: Presets seed system prompt and defaults
Builds green and smoke covers persist + agent turn path
